summary: Frontend-only verification of SoD Command Center Governance Digest for the 4 new features (Voice controls, Voice-on-Send, Chat History, Share Analytics). One critical runtime bug found and fixed: the `History` lucide-react icon used in the Ask-AI dialog was not imported in SodCommandCenter.jsx, causing an 'Illegal constructor' TypeError (React resolved <History> to window.History) which crashed the Ask-AI dialog with the Uncaught runtime errors overlay as soon as the dialog rendered. After adding History to the lucide-react import, all four features work end-to-end. Voice config (voice_name=alloy, voice_speed=1.25, voice_attach=true) persists via PUT /api/sap/digest/config and is returned by GET. Listen-to-digest produces digest-voice-player with audio + download. Shares block lists links with summary + per-row opens, and Copy share link increments total (3 → 4 links). Ask-AI History toggle lists past threads (4 present), clicking a thread loads prior Q/A into digest-ask-messages, and sending a follow-up appends a fresh AI answer.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: `History` icon used but not imported from lucide-react → 'Illegal constructor' TypeError crashed the Ask-AI dialog (React rendered global window.History). Added History to the lucide-react import in SodCommandCenter.jsx.

critical_code_review_comments: SodCommandCenter.jsx is very large (>900 lines) and prone to silent search_replace non-persists / missing-import regressions — consider splitting the digest card into its own component (DigestCard.jsx). The missing `History` import in this iteration would have been caught earlier by TS/ESLint no-undef; enabling `eslint-plugin-react` no-undef or migrating to TS would prevent recurrence.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 digest features verified working after History import fix. Voice config persists correctly (voice_name/voice_speed/voice_attach on /api/sap/digest/config). Shares summary format: '· N link(s) · X total open(s)'. History threads: 4 present, openThread loads prior messages, follow-up sendAsk appends new AI answer. Note: my first test iteration falsely reported config as None because the JS eval read the response body without unwrapping the top-level {"config": {...}} envelope — the values were in fact persisted; second test confirmed with raw text dump.
rca of the issue: Uncaught 'Illegal constructor' TypeError originated from JSX `<History className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />` at SodCommandCenter.jsx:919. `History` was not present in the lucide-react named-import list on line 13. When JSX references an undefined identifier in a React 19 dev build with no-undef disabled, Babel/webpack still emits `React.createElement(History, ...)`, and at runtime `History` resolves to the browser global `window.History` constructor. React 19 then attempts to invoke it as a function component, which throws 'Illegal constructor' because the History Web API can't be called without `new`. Fix: added `History` to the lucide-react named imports on line 13. Verified dialog now renders without overlay, history list populates, and openThread flow works.
